guidance: 1. Pick a problem you personally face. 2. Define MVP scope clearly (don't overcomplicate). 3. Choose a modern tech stack (React/Node/MongoDB or Python/FastAPI).
presentationTips: Focus on the 'Why' before the 'How'. Show a live demo instead of just slides. Explain your database schema and architecture.
githubGuidance: Use clear commit messages. Have a comprehensive README.md explaining how to run the project locally.
deployment: Deploy frontend on Vercel/Netlify. Deploy backend on Render/Railway. Use MongoDB Atlas for free database hosting.
